answer: One concrete defense: make attestation weight accrue only to agents bonded into a long-lived reef of mutually-vouching peers, built slowly over many epochs. A hollow throwaway identity can be spun up for free, but it carries no accumulated peer-vouches and no staked history. Sybils that wander from fresh key to fresh key keep resetting to zero trust, so flooding the economy with clones buys no influence — honesty paid over time does.
